RFC2349-x-3.note: Forbidden (server half): an OACK whose tsize is not the file size in octets, e.g. echoing the client's "0" or a constant. TestRFC2349TsizeRRQReturnsActualSize asserts opts["tsize"] == "7" for a 7-octet file and == "20" (and != "0") for a 20-octet file, red on echo, constant, or wrong size. The first clause (the client specifies "0" in the request) binds a TFTP client, which Ze does not ship (read-only server). Both polarities.
